title_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 7)
description_en: Anthropomorphism According to Ibn Taymiyya and His Followers (Episode 7), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: A continuation of the discussion analyzing anthropomorphic doctrines attributed to Ibn Taymiyya and his school of thought.
